// END MAP

const GROUPS = { notifications: "Notifications", interface: "Interface", themes: "Themes",
  terminal: "Terminal", remote_hosts: "Remote Hosts", developer: "Developer" }
const LOOK = {
  exact: { label: "Exact", symbol: "gearshape", tone: () => cmux.theme.accent },
  related: { label: "Related", symbol: "gearshape", tone: () => cmux.theme.warning },
  unavailable: { label: "Unavailable", symbol: "info.circle", tone: () => cmux.theme.text.secondary }
}
const message = e => e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
const rows = MAP.map(([id, title, status, setting, note]) =>
  ({ id, title, status, setting, note, group: GROUPS[id.split(".")[2]] || id.split(".")[2] }))
const counts = status => rows.filter(r => r.status === status).length

function open(r) {
  if (!r.setting) return cmux.toast({ title: r.title, message: r.note })
  return cmux.actions.run("openSettings", { setting: r.setting }).catch(e =>
    cmux.toast({ title: "Could not open Settings", message: message(e), tone: "warning" }))
}
const matches = (r, q) => !q || [r.title, r.id, r.setting, r.note, r.group]
  .some(v => String(v || "").toLowerCase().includes(q))

function row(r) {
  return Row({
    title: () => r().title,
    subtitle: () => [r().group, r().setting, r().note].filter(Boolean).join(" · "),
    symbol: () => LOOK[r().status].symbol,
    tint: () => LOOK[r().status].tone(),
    badge: () => LOOK[r().status].label
  }).help(() => r().id).onTap(() => open(r()))
}

function renderNavigator() {
  const [query, setQuery] = signal("")
  const [only, setOnly] = signal(null)
  const visible = computed(() => {
    const q = query().trim().toLowerCase()
    return rows.filter(r => (!only() || r.status === only()) && matches(r, q))
  })
  const filter = status => Button(() => (only() === status ? "• " : "") +
    (status ? `${LOOK[status].label} (${counts(status)})` : `All (${rows.length})`), () => setOnly(status))
  return VStack([
    Text("Rex Settings").font("title").weight("semibold"),
    Text("Each Rex preference, opened at the cmux setting that matches it.").color(cmux.theme.text.secondary),
    TextField(query, { placeholder: "Search preferences, ids or cmux keys", onEdit: setQuery,
      onSubmit: () => { const first = visible()[0]; if (first) open(first) } }),
    HStack([filter(null), filter("exact"), filter("related"), filter("unavailable")]),
    ForEach({ items: visible, key: r => r.id }, row),
    () => visible().length ? null
      : EmptyState({ title: "No matching preferences", message: "Change the search or the filter.", symbol: "gearshape" })
  ])
}

globalThis.__cmuxAppExports = { renderNavigator }
